elements.title: Salient Statistics—United States
elements.content:
|                                   | 2019 | 2020 | 2021 | 2022 | 2023e |
|-----------------------------------|------|------|------|------|-------|
| Production, mine1                 | 565  | 578  | 504  | 295  | 310   |
| Imports for consumption           | 136  | 90   | 87   | 102  | 81    |
| Exports                          | 11   | 8    | 11   | 14   | 11    |
| Consumption, apparent2            | 690  | 660  | 580  | 383  | 380   |
| Price, average unit value, f.o.b. mine or mill, dollars per metric ton | 28   | 31   | 46   | 65   | 68    |
| Employment, mine and mill, number | 140  | 140  | 140  | 140  | 140   |
| Net import reliance3 as a percentage of apparent consumption | 18   | 12   | 13   | 23   | 18    |
elements.notes:
1 Mine production includes pumice and pumicite.
2 Apparent consumption is production plus imports minus exports.
3 Net import reliance = (Imports - Exports) / Apparent Consumption x 100.
2023e = estimated.
